panels.title: Resolved Live Opportunities Stopped by Execution Gates
panels.description: One opportunity per process and market. Dollar values assume the first blocked quote filled in full; actual live fillability is unknown.

panels.title: Quoted-Fill Outcome by First Gate (7d)
panels.description: Distinct officially resolved process-market opportunities. Correctness describes the prediction, not an actual live trade.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT d.process_id, d.market_id, d.decision_id, d.decision_at, d.outcome,
         d.executable_price, d.fee_per_share, d.size, d.status,
         COALESCE(
           d.metadata #>> '{order_plan,orders,0,request,metadata,live_execution_gate,gate_reason}',
           CASE WHEN d.status = 'admission_blocked'
                THEN d.metadata #>> '{entry_admission,blocking_policies,0}' END,
           CASE WHEN d.status = 'risk_blocked' THEN 'risk_blocked_unclassified' END,
           CASE WHEN d.status = 'shadow_only' THEN 'execution_disabled' END
         ) AS gate_reason
  FROM polymarket.btc_strategy_decisions d
  WHERE d.execution_mode = 'live' AND d.action = 'buy'
    AND d.decision_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz
    AND d.process_id::text ~ '^(${process_id:regex})$'
), blocked AS (
  SELECT s.*, row_number() OVER (
           PARTITION BY s.process_id, s.market_id ORDER BY s.decision_at, s.decision_id
         ) AS blocked_rank,
         count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY s.process_id, s.market_id) AS blocked_attempts
  FROM selected s
  WHERE s.gate_reason IS NOT NULL
), opportunities AS (
  SELECT b.process_id, b.market_id, b.decision_at, b.outcome AS prediction,
         b.gate_reason, b.blocked_attempts, b.executable_price, b.fee_per_share, b.size,
         m.official_outcome,
         CASE WHEN m.official_outcome IS NOT NULL AND b.executable_price IS NOT NULL
                    AND b.size > 0 AND b.fee_per_share IS NOT NULL
              THEN b.size * ((CASE WHEN b.outcome = m.official_outcome THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
                    - b.executable_price - b.fee_per_share)
         END AS quoted_fill_pnl
  FROM blocked b
  LEFT JOIN polymarket.btc_interval_markets m ON m.market_id = b.market_id
  WHERE b.blocked_rank = 1
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM selected s
      WHERE s.process_id = b.process_id AND s.market_id = b.market_id
        AND s.status IN ('submitted', 'filled')
    )
)
SELECT gate_reason AS "Gate",
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE prediction = official_outcome) AS "Correct prediction",
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE prediction <> official_outcome) AS "Wrong prediction"
             FROM opportunities WHERE official_outcome IS NOT NULL
             GROUP BY gate_reason ORDER BY count(*) DESC

panels.title: Potential PnL at Blocked Quote by First Gate (7d)
panels.description: USD what-if at the first blocked decision's full quoted size and price, including quoted fee. Negative values are potential losses avoided; positive values are potential profit missed. Fillability is unknown.

  WHERE d.execution_mode = 'live' AND d.action = 'buy'
    AND d.decision_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz

), opportunities AS (
  SELECT b.process_id, b.market_id, b.decision_at, b.outcome AS prediction,
         b.gate_reason, b.blocked_attempts, b.executable_price, b.fee_per_share, b.size,
         m.official_outcome,
         CASE WHEN m.official_outcome IS NOT NULL AND b.executable_price IS NOT NULL
                    AND b.size > 0 AND b.fee_per_share IS NOT NULL
              THEN b.size * ((CASE WHEN b.outcome = m.official_outcome THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
                    - b.executable_price - b.fee_per_share)
         END AS quoted_fill_pnl
  FROM blocked b
  LEFT JOIN polymarket.btc_interval_markets m ON m.market_id = b.market_id
  WHERE b.blocked_rank = 1
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM selected s
      WHERE s.process_id = b.process_id AND s.market_id = b.market_id
        AND s.status IN ('submitted', 'filled')
    )
)
SELECT gate_reason AS "Gate",
                    round(sum(-quoted_fill_pnl) FILTER (WHERE quoted_fill_pnl < 0), 2) AS "Potential loss avoided",
                    round(sum(quoted_fill_pnl) FILTER (WHERE quoted_fill_pnl > 0), 2) AS "Potential profit missed"
             FROM opportunities WHERE official_outcome IS NOT NULL
             GROUP BY gate_reason ORDER BY count(*) DESC

panels.title: Unresolved or Unpriced Blocked Opportunities (7d)
panels.description: Distinct blocked process-market opportunities without an official outcome or a complete quote. These are excluded from dollar estimates.

panels.title: Blocked Opportunity Detail (7d)
panels.description: First blocked decision per process and market. Attempts count repeated local vetoes. Quoted-fill PnL is hypothetical and is not paper or live realized PnL.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT d.process_id, d.market_id, d.decision_id, d.decision_at, d.outcome,
         d.executable_price, d.fee_per_share, d.size, d.status,
         COALESCE(

                THEN d.metadata #>> '{entry_admission,blocking_policies,0}' END,
           CASE WHEN d.status = 'risk_blocked' THEN 'risk_blocked_unclassified' END,
           CASE WHEN d.status = 'shadow_only' THEN 'execution_disabled' END
         ) AS gate_reason
  FROM polymarket.btc_strategy_decisions d
  WHERE d.execution_mode = 'live' AND d.action = 'buy'
    AND d.decision_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz
    AND d.process_id::text ~ '^(${process_id:regex})$'
), blocked AS (
  SELECT s.*, row_number() OVER (
           PARTITION BY s.process_id, s.market_id ORDER BY s.decision_at, s.decision_id
         ) AS blocked_rank,
         count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY s.process_id, s.market_id) AS blocked_attempts
  FROM selected s
  WHERE s.gate_reason IS NOT NULL
), opportunities AS (
  SELECT b.process_id, b.market_id, b.decision_at, b.outcome AS prediction,
         b.gate_reason, b.blocked_attempts, b.executable_price, b.fee_per_share, b.size,
         m.official_outcome,
         CASE WHEN m.official_outcome IS NOT NULL AND b.executable_price IS NOT NULL
                    AND b.size > 0 AND b.fee_per_share IS NOT NULL
              THEN b.size * ((CASE WHEN b.outcome = m.official_outcome THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
                    - b.executable_price - b.fee_per_share)
         END AS quoted_fill_pnl
  FROM blocked b
  LEFT JOIN polymarket.btc_interval_markets m ON m.market_id = b.market_id
  WHERE b.blocked_rank = 1
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM selected s
      WHERE s.process_id = b.process_id AND s.market_id = b.market_id
        AND s.status IN ('submitted', 'filled')
    )
)
SELECT process_id AS "Process", market_id AS "Market",
                    decision_at AS "First blocked at", gate_reason AS "First gate",
                    blocked_attempts AS "Blocked attempts", prediction AS "Prediction",
                    official_outcome AS "Official outcome",
                    CASE WHEN official_outcome IS NULL THEN 'unresolved'
                         WHEN prediction = official_outcome THEN 'correct'
                         ELSE 'wrong' END AS "Prediction result",
                    round(quoted_fill_pnl, 2) AS "Quoted-fill PnL (USD)"
             FROM opportunities ORDER BY decision_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Model Policy Check Failures
panels.description: Each failed check counts independently; an inference may fail more than one policy check.

panels.title: Resolved Confidence Rejections
panels.description: Officially resolved prediction directions, weighted by evaluation. Confidence-only means share cost and stressed edge passed; confidence-and-edge means share cost passed. These are not distinct trades or profit.

panels.title: Selected Entry Intents and Venue POSTs
panels.description: Approved live entry intents versus actual venue POST attempts by registered model member. POST attempts are a subset, not fills.

panels.title: Entry Intent Veto Reasons
panels.description: Exclusive first stop for selected approved live entry intents; venue POST attempts are tracked separately.

panels.title: Reconciliation Entry Safety
panels.description: Latest process-scoped reconciliation evidence only. Submission-risk evidence is shown separately below.

panels.title: Reconciliation Latency by Source
panels.description: p50 and p95 process-scoped reconciliation duration. Inference scheduling is independent of these runs.

panels.title: Integrity State
panels.description: Latest mismatches and unresolved orders. Nonzero values remain actionable even when transport is healthy.

panels.title: Live Order Latency
panels.description: Independent p50 and p95 latency stages. No quantiles are added together.

panels.title: Primary Execution vs Stress Preview
panels.description: Primary execution latency remains independent from non-mutating preview completion.

panels.title: Candidate Evaluation Lag
panels.description: Delay from the scheduled candidate timestamp to actual evaluation; sustained growth represents opportunity loss risk.

panels.title: Stress Preview Health
panels.description: Preview work is bounded and cannot apply backpressure to primary execution.

panels.title: Actionable Stale Settlements
panels.description: Filled orders whose official resolution, local projection, durable watch, or settlement ledger is incomplete. Paper pending credits are actionable; live winners awaiting proven redemption are excluded.

panels.title: Oldest Actionable Settlement Age
panels.description: Age since market close for the oldest settlement that the process must still repair.

panels.title: Settlement Resolution Pipeline
panels.description: Exact incomplete stage for each process-owned filled order after market close.

panels.title: Settlement Auto-Healing
panels.description: Durable canonical resolution evidence or watches recovered by the process reconciliation loop.

panels.title: Submission Risk Evidence
panels.description: Result of the most recent qualified live pre-submit evidence check. This is independent from reconciliation safety.

panels.title: Submission Risk Check Age
panels.description: Age of the last qualified live pre-submit risk evaluation; absence means no qualified live attempt since process registration.

panels.title: Daily Resolved Net PnL
panels.description: Validated economic PnL by official-resolution UTC day, including winners awaiting redemption without double counting credited settlements.

panels.title: Daily Loss Headroom
panels.description: Distance between validated daily resolved PnL and the configured daily-loss limit at the latest qualified submission.

panels.title: Live Submission Risk Outcomes
panels.description: Every qualified live risk check has one bounded outcome and reason before the venue POST.

panels.title: Daily PnL Settlement Evidence
panels.description: Counts of economically resolved live settlements used by the latest daily-loss calculation, separated from redemption completion.

panels.title: Live Open Exposure Admission
panels.description: Validated unresolved exposure before and after the proposed order. Officially resolved positions are excluded even while redemption remains pending.

panels.title: Open Markets & Pending Redemption
panels.description: Open market occupancy before and after the proposed order, plus redemption liquidity state. A pending redemption may be one while open-market count remains zero.

panels.title: Live Order Path In Flight
panels.description: Process-scoped live order invocations that have not reached an explicit terminal outcome. A sustained nonzero value indicates a stuck internal execution stage.

panels.title: Unclassified Live Path Exits
panels.description: Live order-path invocations that exited without a bounded terminal classification. Any nonzero result is an instrumentation or execution-control defect.

panels.title: Live Path Activity Age
panels.description: Seconds since the most recent internal live-order transition. No data means the process has not qualified a live order since this runtime started.

panels.title: Internal Live Order Stage Latency
panels.description: p50 and p95 latency for authentication, risk and metadata, order construction, signing, persistence, final guards, venue POST, and total submission. These measurements are local and never perform I/O on the order path.

panels.title: Live Order Terminal Outcomes
panels.description: Exactly one bounded terminal outcome per live order-path invocation. Venue rejection, local safety rejection, ambiguity, deduplication, acknowledgement, and unclassified errors remain distinct.

panels.title: Live Order Execution Funnel
panels.description: Bounded internal transitions after a qualified order reaches the live venue. Each series identifies the exact stage and outcome where execution advanced or stopped.

panels.title: CLOB Timeouts by Stage
panels.description: Bounded guarded CLOB deadline expirations by operation stage.

panels.title: Submission Lock Wait
panels.description: p95 wait for serialized live-submission ownership.

panels.title: Unresolved Submit Unknown Orders
panels.description: Durable ambiguous submissions and the age of the oldest unresolved order.

panels.title: Approved Decisions Without Order Result
panels.description: Approved live decisions older than the execution deadline with no durable order result.

panels.title: Transport Failure Runtime Outcome
panels.description: Transport-class failures that preserved the process versus unexpected runtime termination.

panels.title: Live Fill Read Latency
panels.description: p50 and p95 client-observed store read duration by actual call site. Includes pool wait, SQL execution, transfer, and decoding; excludes query errors and downstream fill processing. No process attribution is inferred.

panels.title: Live Fill Read Call Rate
panels.description: Estimated completed store read calls per second by fixed operation, call site, and query result. An identity miss means the joined fill row was absent; it does not imply a reconciliation failure.

panels.title: Live Fill Read Client Time
panels.description: Prometheus estimate of total client-observed time in completed reads over ten minutes, including errors. It is not PostgreSQL CPU time; compare with independent database CPU evidence and call counts.
